name: Greater Insignia of the Horde
what: Use: Removes all movement impairing effects and all effects which cause loss of control of your character. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Brittle Trap
what: Use: Renders a target unable to move for 10 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Holy Hand Grenade of Alterac
what: Use: Inflicts 300 to 500 Holy damage to targets in a 3 yds radius. May occasionally backfire and imbue targets with the power of the Light. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Riverglades Marsh Gas
what: Use: Reduces movement speed by 50% and increases Fire damage taken by all targets in a 5 yard radius by 15 for 15 sec. (15 Sec Cooldown)

name: Loose Clearcutter Blade
what: Use: Launches a sawblade at the target, inflicting 40 damage and causing them to bleed for 72 damage over 18 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Lichbane
what: Use: Stuns target Undead for 6 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Thaelemaches' Talisman
what: Use: Fear all Demons within 15 yds for 6 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Everlook Pathcarver
what: Use: Deal 607 Physical damage split between up to 4 nearby enemies. Deals 2 times as much damage to Plants. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Everlook Delivery Bot
what: Use: Marks a target for delivery. After landing 6 to 8 spells or attacks, deal 467 Fire damage. Number of spells or attacks is halved in Snowy areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Parachute-Priest Pager
what: Use: Page Everlook Emergency Services for a Parachute-Priest that will assist in healing allies for 15 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Defender of the Barkskin
what: Use: Calls forth a Barkskin Ancestor to fight at your side and heal you for 20 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Adaptive Combat Assistant
what: Use: Absorbs 450 damage for 15 sec. If this shield expires before 15 sec, 90 to 110 Nature damage will be dealt to all enemies in melee range. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Weakness Analyzer
what: Use: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 5% for 20 sec or until you deal a non-periodic critical effect. (6 Min Cooldown)

name: Transformative Cocoon
what: Use: Absorb up to 260 to 300 damage and Stun yourself for 5 sec. When the Stun expires, gain 60% increased movement speed for 8 sec. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Mysticbloom Seed
what: Use: Stuns and heals you for 1,480 over 8 sec. In Forest and Grassland areas, gain 10 Stamina for 10 min. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Power Recycler
what: Use: Converts 20% of your maximum health into 20% of your maximum mana, energy, or rage. (2 Min Cooldown)

name: Foxtail Ward
what: Use: Causes all Beasts in a 10 yard radius to run away for 10 sec. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Warding Candle
what: Use: Attempts to remove 1 Curse or Bane, and 1 Disease from the igniter. (1 Min Cooldown)

name: Scented Runewood Brooch
what: Equip: Harmful spell casts and attacks against Furbolg have a chance to deal 84 to 126 Nature damage. Use: Charm target Furbolg for 20 sec. Only works on targets not in combat. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Satchel of Potions
what: Use: Reach into the bag and hope for the best. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Field Agent Beverage
what: Equip: Reduces the hit chance of Charm effects against you by 6%. Use: Increases your effective stealth detection level by 3 for 10 sec, then reduces your effective stealth detection level by 6 for 20 sec. (3 Min Cooldown)

name: Depleted Eye of Influence
what: Equip: Chance on harmful spell cast to reduce target's attack power by 60 for 30 sec.

name: Golden Banana
what: Use: Increases all attributes by 16 for 15 sec. Effect and duration are doubled in Forest and Grassland areas. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Defender's Grip Stabilizer
what: Use: Increases your Block chance by 8% for 15 sec. This effect is doubled in Strongholds and Cities. (6 Min Cooldown)

name: Toy Soldier
what: Use: Increases your chance to Dodge by 3% for 20 sec. This effect is doubled in Strongholds and Cities. (5 Min Cooldown)

name: Serenity Field
what: Use: Increases Spirit by 72 for 15 sec. (6 Min Cooldown)

name: Deep-Sea Waders
what: Use: Lets you walk on water for 1 min. (30 Min Cooldown)

name: Surfer Shoes
what: Use: Gain the ability to walk on water for 5 min. Attacking or taking damage will cancel this effect. (1 Hr Cooldown)

name: Mirage Mirror
what: Use: Increases movement speed by 25% for 10 sec. While out of combat in Desert areas, gain an additional 25% movement speed and become invisible. (10 Min Cooldown)

name: Rusty Propeller Blade
what: Use: Perform a Propellerstorm, reducing your fall speed for 15 sec and dealing 100% weapon damage to nearby enemies when you land. (15 Min Cooldown)

name: Cremation Longbow

name: Rot-Covered Harpoon

what: Toy: Unholster your Replica Ironforge Air Rifle for a friendly shootout. (10 Sec Cooldown)

what: Toy: Pour a glass of Silvermoon Shimmerwine.

what: Use: They love me... (3 Sec Cooldown)
